title: Mercenary, Sherlock and PC reconstruction discovery
summary: Review 40 pinned repositories: add 20 projects and record twenty deferrals or duplicates.
notes: Root personally searched 30 repository queries across C64, ZX Spectrum, Amiga, Atari ST, CPC and DOS/Windows. Screened against current main at 5470 projects. Reviewed 40 available pinned trees, primary documentation and selected implementation/build files; three additional candidates could not be read and were not promoted. Atari ST Mercenary and Spectrum Sherlock are included; no qualifying new CPC addition established. Source and modern host platforms remain distinct. Partial source recovery is not called a complete game; binary parity claims are attributed and bounded. No candidate programs, dependency installers or game images executed. Only exact UTF-8 proof bodies are sealed; larger implementation files are linked and selectively inspected. No worker, branch or PR used.

sources.reason: Recreates Amiga Biplane Duel as a two-player browser dogfight, with throttle/stall behavior, firing, overheating, parachutes and power-ups. Native JavaScript game state rather than an Amiga executable wrapper.
Early native 6502 recreation of William Hennebois' 1985 Thomson TO7 Androïdes. Reconstructs title/menu, ten level maps, crates and hero/pursuer sprite placement on C64 hardware.
Recreates Toggle Booleans' 1993 Windows 3.1 Amazon Skulls grid game in JavaScript. Implements legal bordering moves, turn/win logic, undo and local multiplayer with configurable boards.

Native reconstruction of Beach Life / Virtual Resort: Spring Break from a pinned recovered baseline plus ordered source patches. Host calls reconstructed WinMain through native file/input/graphics services; original executable is not launched.

Partial reconstruction of Melbourne House Sherlock, including parser, world state, NPC domain programs and cab economy. NPC runtime expressly executes recovered game-domain rules, not CPU dispatch; original emulator is an offline reference route.

Independent clean-room-style Paint.NET reimplementation with layers, drawing tools, curves, effects and plugin-related functionality. Rust curve editor implements control points and channel selection with native state and tests.
Preserves split address-labelled C++ decompiler output, WinMain and mathematical helpers for Operation Blockade 2002, with a Visual Studio project and missing-identifier/error-repair artifacts.
C++20/SDL2 port reconstructed from Atari ST Mercenary. Combat uses semantic object slots and positions; original workspace is represented by typed camera, object, inventory and rendering structures.

Functional reconstruction of Project I.G.I. EU release with typed C game objects and original-layout globals. A standalone igidecomp.exe binds calls directly to recovered functions; a separate dinput.dll route replaces functions inside the original for validation.

Reverse-engineers Age of Wonders 1 Delphi packages, RTTI/VMTs, DFM forms, resources and rules into a C++ engine/UI/data workspace. Economy notes cite original functions; native menu/world screens reconstruct observed behavior.

Reconstructs the March 2004 Earth & Beyond client, combining reverse-engineered game-specific C++ with adapted Westwood library source published by EA. Buff database source ties semantic classes and INI parsing to original function addresses.

Java recreation with ball motion and board subdivision: Board splits the active rectangle and keeps only regions containing balls, tracking captured-area goals. Applet and desktop launchers are present.

Recreates Nagymathe Denes' -DEFORMERS- / TEREP2 soft-body simulator in Rust, retaining original 16.16 fixed-point physics contracts, masses/springs, damage and height-map terrain. Simulation tick is semantic native Rust.

Unreal Engine 4 recreation of MiceMen with typed grid blocks, team mice, column shifting/wrapping and selection controls. Source implements title-specific board mechanics rather than only an asset scene.
Java recreation with player movement, climbing, jetpack, shooting, lives, score and level transitions. Uses a custom game implementation rather than a general engine.

Recreates Scorched Earth artillery, wind, terrain destruction, armoury and turns in a deterministic shared simulation with authoritative multiplayer server. Source explicitly tunes wind and other constants for the remake.

Browser recreation of DOS Tomaattisota, with entity/components, player status, power-ups, lives and last-player-standing rules. Repository description supplies title lineage; inspected source implements the rules.
2010/2011 HTML5 recreation of DOS BRIX, preserving a tile-based puzzle with authored level arrays, selectable sprites, time/score and stage state.
Web adaptation of Raptor: Call of the Shadows drawing on the released DOS source for movement, weapons, formations and flight paths. Native MoveSobj/MoveEobj-style algorithms appear in TypeScript.

Recreates the 1996 Korean-distributed Eclipse strategy RPG using decoded assets and native TypeScript battle rules. Original-edition code cites segmented addresses, float32/truncation behavior and the original unsigned-division coma-status quirk.
Windows 11 handheld SteamOS-style shell, not reconstruction of a legacy game or application in this focused pass.
Source game is Sega CD, outside the focused computer-platform pass. Tree also contains a modeled Sega CD/Musashi runtime; do not infer native recovered game logic from the repository description.
Reconstructed Nintendo 64 Top Gear Rally, outside the requested computer-platform scope; modern build host is not the source platform.
PS2 static-recompilation/hardware-runtime framework with VU/IOP interpreters, not a DOS/Windows original or a proven complete commercial game reconstruction; outside this pass.

Targets Sega Model 2A/i960 Virtua Fighter 2, not the Windows edition. Preserves CPU/condition-code/mutable-memory state with bounded hardware modeling; outside this platform pass and requires architecture audit before native-port classification.
Atari 2600 Combat terminal conversion with custom TIA rendering, not Atari ST. Outside the focused source platforms; no native PC original implied by host.

Real C decompilation source exists, but seg01 preserves segmented memory/frames and CALL_ORIG/rt_call_far paths within a Win16 harness. Needs execution-path audit; do not present it as a standalone native playable port on README goals alone.
Android prototype draws manhole cover and walkers, but update() only increments x; falling and movement direction are TODOs. Core crossing/failure rules not established.

WebGL prototype renders an advancing block track and vehicle; inspected main.js does not establish jumping, collision or original SkyRoads game rules. Defer until title-specific gameplay is demonstrated.

Unity card-game source is present, but README only says old DOS game remake. Exact original title/version/publisher and reconstruction relationship remain unresolved; avoid assuming generic King card rules identify a particular DOS application.

Godot movement/AI components exist, but CrushComponent is only an exported reference, with no complete Beast rule reconstruction established. project.godot also requests lowercase scenes/main.tscn while the tree has Scenes/main.tscn; no runnable claim.

Fork of dkfans/keeperfx. Inspected README is upstream Windows-focused and the tree exposes no Amiga-named build source; repository name alone is insufficient to assert an independent Amiga port. Needs fork-delta/platform evidence.
GitHub identifies a fork of mrxenginner/reVC. No independently reviewed divergent reconstruction established; defer lineage/platform review rather than add another GTA Vice City source mirror.
GitHub fork of already tracked Pyrdacor/Amberstar.net; no independent new project established.
GitHub fork of already tracked levincem/dungeonMaster-codex; avoid duplicate catalogue entry without established independent scope.
GitHub fork of tracked kmatveev/zx-sof-reveng; same Soldier of Fortune Spectrum analysis lineage.
GitHub fork of tracked awkto/zeliard-decomp; no independently reviewed divergent source recovery established.
GitHub fork of tracked sjmelia/civd; avoid duplicating Civilization DOS source reconstruction.
GitHub fork of tracked tuunanet/rea-ski-or-die-reconstruction; no independent new Snowball War reconstruction established.
GitHub fork of tracked adamberces/TrailBlazeR; same C64/Amiga-derived remake lineage.
